verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents tools to work with the Stripe API and search Stripe's knowledge base, and a probe confirms it at docs.stripe.com/mcp. That evidence covers Stripe as a whole, though, and does not show which Issuing operations (cards, cardholders, authorizations) are exposed as MCP tools. Missing for 10: evidence of Issuing-specific MCP tool coverage, setup/auth details for connecting an agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
